# Sven Hardy Benson’s Shelf

> Deliberately released editions by Sven Hardy Benson, plus a small number of explicitly labeled public proofs.

This file is the low-noise machine-readable map of Sven Hardy Benson’s Shelf. A book is a released edition only when its book README says `Published` and it appears in the root `README.md` table under `## The books`.

## Primary entry points

- [Shelf home](https://svyable.github.io/shelf/) — public Shelf front door.
- [Shelf Reader](https://svyable.github.io/shelf/reader/) — human-facing Reader for released editions.
- [Repository overview](https://svyable.github.io/shelf/README.md) — publication model and human released-book catalog.
- [Agent guidance](https://svyable.github.io/shelf/AGENTS.md) — repository rules for agents modifying Shelf content.
- [Sitemap](https://svyable.github.io/shelf/sitemap.xml) — canonical public discovery URLs.
- [Working Desk](https://svyable.github.io/desk/reader/) — current working drafts and next editions.
